small_sample_warning: Based on 253 scored option callouts posted 2026-06-08 to 2026-10-13 from public channels. Scores are hold-to-expiry intrinsic value against the entry price the channel quoted, with no slippage or fees; most are same-day index and large-cap options. Channels usually quote early exits, which are not what is scored here. A limited sample, not a settled rate, and not advice.
quoted_results_are_channel_claims: quoted_results_are_channel_claims: result_pct is what the channel itself posted, not verified, and winners dominate quoted closes (survivorship). Use 'outcome' (scored against the real tape) where present.
